root_causes.description: Recommendation service experienced extreme CPU usage spike (z=+810.80) far above pre-incident baseline of ~0.025, indicating CPU stress causing service degradation and elevated latency across dependent services

remediation_steps: Restart recommendation service pods to immediately relieve CPU pressure
Investigate CPU-intensive processes, potential loops, or memory leaks in recommendation service code
Review recent deployments or configuration changes to recommendation service
Add CPU resource limits or scale recommendation deployment if consistently under-provisioned
